description: Materials, finishes and strengths the Printlooper print shops offer, with how many shops offer each and how many colors each material comes in. Pass material, finish or color_family to list the colors, 50 at a time.

color_family.description: List the colors in this family, for example blue (ids are in color_families)

finish.description: List the colors in this finish, for example matte or glossy

limit.description: With a filter: how many colors to list

material.description: List the colors of this material, for example PLA or PETG

offset.description: With a filter: skip this many colors. Pass next_offset from the answer before

name: list_materials
title: List materials and colors
